questions.question: What content and behavior should the portfolio include?
questions.recommendedChoice: A static portfolio with About, Skills, Projects, and Contact sections; semantic landmarks, accessible links, and responsive styling.
questions.answer: Create exactly index.html and styles.css as the final app files. Use HTML5 lang=en, viewport metadata, descriptive title and meta description, and a stylesheet link. Include a semantic header with the developer name and About, Skills, Projects, and Contact navigation; a main element with four matching-id sections; and a footer with the copyright year. About has a 2–3 sentence placeholder bio and an image placeholder with meaningful alt text. Skills is an unordered list containing exactly HTML, CSS, JavaScript, PHP, MySQL, Node.js, Next.js, and Git. Projects has three article cards, each with an h3, description, and link. Contact has a mailto link and GitHub and LinkedIn links. Use exactly one h1 and logical heading levels. styles.css contains only a modern reset. No framework, backend, datastore, or JavaScript implementation.
questions.rationale: The user supplied exact content, file, markup, and styling constraints.
